description: Rigid STIGA Play Off figure molds (docs/players.md). Figure-local MOLD units (~mm before the fitted scale in 'scale'): origin = mounting (fixture) axis at the underside of the mount socket (ice plane), +z up the axis, +x = facing direction, +y = the figure's LEFT. Body = metaball parts (ellipsoids, capsules, rounded boxes; surface at the stated semi-axes/radius). Shapes are operator readings of the user's photos/videos refined by camera-matched silhouette fits (scripts/fit-figure-views.py, scripts/fit-figure-shape.py): status traced; hidden details (bore, blade thickness) assumed.

paint.note: Skin seen between the goalie mask, its smooth back plate and the collar: two crescents (about 18-22 deg wide) curving from near the crown (el ~58, az ~140) round the sides (az ~100-122 at ear level) to the jaw, where they join the nape skin below the back plate (plate edge at el ~+10 at the centre). Read from the back/side/top photos (IMG_2566/2567/2572) and the rotation video at 7.75 s against azimuth/elevation lines projected through the fitted cameras. Polygons in azimuth (0 = facing, +90 = left) / elevation about the head centre; faces along the borders are subdivided 'refine' times so the colour edge is smooth.

scale.note: k = measured height / mold height; the blade is set from the measured length and height.

pad_l.note: Leg-pad bottom footprint (contact shape), mold units.

pad_r.note: Leg-pad bottom footprint (contact shape), mold units.

W.note: Team W = Finland (reference variant, decision D4).

E.note: Team E = Sweden (reference variant; the user's own Sweden figures supply the mold).

W-G.note: Mostly hidden under the mask in the overhead; read as 31 (low confidence).

W-RW.note: Number hidden in the overhead: the country name only.

E-G.note: Overhead reference goalie no. 30; the user's Sweden goalie is also no. 30.

E-C.note: The user's Sweden skater (photos/videos) is also no. 21.

prints_note: Back prints per player: country name (team kit) over the jersey number. Numbers are the OFFICIAL OVERHEAD reference variant; the user's own figures' numbers are unknown except Sweden skater no. 21 and goalie no. 30 (user media). Fonts approximate the moulded print (DejaVu Sans Bold name, DejaVu Serif Bold numbers).

albedo_srgb.note: Plastic albedo (sRGB) for the figure materials. Neutral white balance from the official overhead (validation/18-colour-samples.json and medians of all figure pixels: blue (18,88,141) all-pixel, (56,129,190) lit helmet top; yellow (217,168,6)); hue and saturation checked against the user photos (warm indoor light: deep royal blue, orange-yellow, orange skin). Status: traced from photos, white balance assumed neutral in the overhead. Round 3 (2026-10-01): blue desaturated after a same-camera comparison - photo blue HSV median hue 109/sat ~145 (OpenCV units, 12 views) vs render sat ~185 at the old albedo [30,100,182]; hue unchanged within 2.

print_layout.note: Back print layout in mold units on the decal sheet (sheet size = projector size in build_figures.PRINT). Block digits + sans name from assets/blender/print_glyphs.py; proportions traced from IMG_2566/IMG_2570 (goalie 30) and the skater turntable back views (21). Ink: Sweden near-black with a near-black outline; Finland blue (official overhead).

definitions.height: top of the mask to the bottom of the figure (socket underside = ice plane)
definitions.blade_length: along the blade's lower edge from the heel bend to the toe
definitions.blade_height: vertical height of the blade plank (at the toe)

goalie.note: User ruler measurements of the actual figure (chat, 2026-10-01), stated as 5,4 / 2,6 / 0,55 cm. Uncertainty not stated (null). The goalie mold scale and blade are set from these; the skater keeps its own (overhead-fitted) scale until measured.

finish.note: Surface finish of the moulded figures (round 5): semi-gloss plastic = base roughness plus a thin clear coat with its own roughness, so highlights stay small and bright as in the user's photos (room lights), instead of the broad white patches of round 4 (rough 0.3 + mirror-like coat under a large area light). Metal stick: brushed steel/aluminium, reflects the environment. Set by visual comparison with the photos (no gloss measurement).
